name: The Dying Ancients
summary: An ancient asks you to face Sunderbark, corrupted beyond saving. A seed may let something good grow from the sorrow.

sections.title: A Friend Lost
sections.body: The ancient tells you that corruption has spread into its roots and touched others as well. Its old friend Sunderbark has been broken by that corruption, and there is no saving him. You are asked to strike the corrupted tree by the pool to the east so Sunderbark will come.

sections.title: A Seed in the Earth
sections.body: When Sunderbark is destroyed, plant the seed in his remains. The ancient hopes something beautiful will grow from the violence. It, too, expects to return to the earth soon, and trusts new blossoms to carry a future for the mountain.

faq.answer: Sunderbark is an ancient and an old friend of the speaker. Corruption has broken him, leaving him beyond saving.

faq.q: What has happened to the ancient?
faq.answer: Corruption is seeping into the ancient's limbs and roots, and it says other ancients have felt it too.
The ancient directs you to strike the corrupted tree by the pool to the east, which will bring Sunderbark.
The seed is to be planted in Sunderbark's remains after he is destroyed.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Dying Ancients
